title: Promissory Note to Jason Brunell, 14 September 1837
source_note: JS, Promissory Note, to Jacinth Buenell [Jason Brunell], Kirtland Township, Geauga Co., OH, 14 Sept. 1837; handwriting of JS; notations of payment in handwriting of Newel K. Whitney, Willard Richards, William Clayton, Brigham Young, and two unidentified scribes; two pages; JS Collection, CHL. One leaf, measuring 4½ × 8¼ inches (11 × 21 cm). The top edge of the recto has the square cut of manufactured paper; the bottom, left, and right edges of the recto were cut. The note was folded in half and then folded twice in a parallel fold. Details of efforts to pay the note are found in subsequent notations on the verso by unidentified scribes, Newel K. Whitney, Willard Richards, and William Clayton. JS’s signature was removed from the note, either to indicate payment when Brigham Young noted on the recto that the note was paid in full or later by a signature collector. The leaf contains marked staining, soiling at the folds, and fly specks. Payment notations by Willard Richards, William Clayton, and Brigham Young indicate continuous institutional custody.
